HomePage.title: Rent a Car
HomePage.metaDescription: Rent a car in 14 cities with Novera Mobility: pick the branch and dates, see the available cars with their prices. Ask for a quote for your company fleet.
HomePage.intro: Choose where to pick up and drop off the car and your dates, and see the cars available at that branch with prices.
HomePage.corporateIntro: Corporate customers do not pick a car and pay: tell us what you need and our sales team will call you.

weekend.title: Hit the road this weekend
weekend.text: Pick up on Friday evening, drop off on Monday morning. A car is ready at one of our branches in 14 cities.

electric.title: A good time to go electric
electric.text: Quiet, clean driving with our electric and hybrid models. See which branch has which model.

fleet.title: Your company fleet, at your door
fleet.text: We bring the cars where you need them and collect them where you finish. Let our corporate team hear what you need.

Guarantee.title: We don't just rent cars, we stand by you on the road
Guarantee.intro: If something goes wrong on the road, you don't have to think about what to do.

sos.title: One tap SOS
sos.text: Press SOS in the app and your location reaches us.

tow.title: The nearest tow is sent
tow.text: By GPS, the closest tow truck sets off to you.

desk.title: Our 24/7 desk calls you
desk.text: We follow the situation through with you.

replacement.title: A replacement car at your door
replacement.text: If the fault lasts over 24 hours, a replacement car is brought to you.
